b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader. It fetches the contents of a web URL and
writes them to a file, or to standard output. See
[`app/cli.py`](app/cli.py) for the implementation.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [options]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download (positional argument) |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Global options

These options are provided by the standard `argparse` library.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | show the help message and exit |
'
